pr_title: Add/fix support for RID, Callable and Signal in editor properties
pr_body:
Callable and Signal editor properties were missing, causing the editor to crash when expanding an array containing one of them. Also, the RID editor property was always showing "Invalid RID" due to missing of serialization.

So, I added serialization for RID and Signal (but not Callable, since it's not always serializable when using custom callables), but maybe it was not the best thing to do?

Then, I added missing editor properties for Signal and Callable, as seen below:
![Editor Properties](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13206601/176569755-179dd010-fca8-4b58-b5db-4f7ee1bceb6b.png)


Fixes #62171
pr_comments:
How does exported Callables behave? Are they not serialized, so upon load they are replaced with null?

It's possible to serialize them, but it's probably complicated to implement. Regular Callable is just object + method name. Then there is CallableCustomBind which is the same + array of arguments and CallableCustomUnbind, which is Callable + int. I think the only non-serializable callable that you can create in GDScript is lambda Callable.

> How does exported Callables behave? Are they not serialized, so upon load they are replaced with null?
> 
> It's possible to serialize them, but it's probably complicated to implement. Regular Callable is just object + method name. Then there is CallableCustomBind which is the same + array of arguments and CallableCustomUnbind, which is Callable + int. I think the only non-serializable callable that you can create in GDScript is lambda Callable.

Yeah, it seems like since they're not serialized, they are replaced with empty Callables.
